section: Growth of the nationalist movement in Andhra, 1885-1905
subsections: Early political associations of Madras Presidency
Andhra delegates at early INC sessions

accepted.s: Who was the first Telugu person to preside over a session of the Indian National Congress?
accepted.x: P. Anandacharlu was the first Telugu person to preside over a session of the Indian National Congress.
accepted.tq: Directly identify the person associated with the distinction.

accepted.s: The 7th session of the Indian National Congress, presided over by P. Anandacharlu, was held at:
accepted.x: The 7th session of the INC was held at Nagpur in 1891 under the presidency of P. Anandacharlu.
accepted.tq: Link the session number with its venue rather than its president alone.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. P. Anandacharlu served as Secretary of the Madras Mahajana Sabha.
2. He served as Secretary of the Madras Mahajana Sabha in 1884.
3. Pattabhi Sitaramayya presided over the Jaipur session of the INC in 1948.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Anandacharlu was Secretary of the Madras Mahajana Sabha in 1884, while Pattabhi Sitaramayya presided over the Jaipur session in 1948.
accepted.tq: Check each statement against the office, year and session details.

accepted.s: The Coconada Literary Association was mainly associated with public affairs in:
accepted.x: The Coconada Literary Association was associated with public affairs in the Godavari region.
accepted.tq: Identify the geographical sphere of a local political association.
accepted.sec: Early political associations of Madras Presidency

accepted.s: Gajula Lakshmi Narasu Chetty, who founded the Madras Native Association, also started which publication in 1844?
accepted.x: Gajula Lakshmi Narasu Chetty started The Crescent in 1844.
accepted.tq: Connect an associated publication with its founder.
accepted.sec: Early political associations of Madras Presidency

accepted.s: The tour of S. N. Banerjee in 1878 was undertaken for which organisation and helped stir political sentiment?
accepted.x: S. N. Banerjee toured in 1878 on behalf of the Indian Association, stimulating political sentiment.
accepted.tq: Match the political leader with the organisation represented during the tour.
accepted.sec: Early political associations of Madras Presidency

accepted.s: The Krishna District Association was formed broadly on the lines suggested at the:
o: First session of the Indian National Congress
Seventh session of the Indian National Congress
accepted.x: The Krishna District Association was formed on the lines suggested at the first session of the INC.
accepted.tq: Link an institutional development with the earlier national event that inspired it.

accepted.s: Who presided over the conference of the Krishna District Association that attracted approximately 223 delegates?
accepted.x: Nyapathi Subbarao presided over the Krishna District Association conference, which attracted approximately 223 delegates.
accepted.tq: Use the presiding officer as the decisive clue in a local association question.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following district associations in chronological order of their formation:
A. Vizag District Association
B. Nellore District Association
C. Krishna District Association
D. Kurnool District Association
accepted.x: The order is Krishna (1892), Vizag (1893), Nellore (1908) and Kurnool (1914).
accepted.tq: Fix the earliest and latest associations first, then place the intermediate years.

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched with the year of formation?
accepted.x: The Vizag District Association was formed in 1893. Anantapur, Nellore, Kurnool and Chittoor–Kadapa were associated with 1907, 1908, 1914 and 1916 respectively.
accepted.tq: Start with the pair whose year is closest to the first district association.

accepted.s: The district associations of Chittoor and Kadapa were formed in:
accepted.x: The Chittoor and Kadapa district associations were formed in 1916.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the paired districts and their later formation year from the preceding entries.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding the early district associations of Andhra is NOT correct?
o: The Anantapur District Association was formed in 1907.
The Kurnool District Association was formed in 1914.
The Nellore District Association was formed in 1908.
The Vizag District Association was formed in 1907.
accepted.x: The Vizag District Association was formed in 1893, not 1907. The other three statements are correct.
accepted.tq: Find the single altered year in an otherwise familiar chronological list.

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Andhra delegate)
a. P. Anandacharlu
a. P. Rangaiah Naidu
c. Nyapathi Subbarao
d. Gutti Kesava Pillai
List-II (Place associated)
i. Chittoor
ii. Rajahmundry
iii. Anantapur
iv. Not specified as a district in the given list

Select the correct answer using the code below:
accepted.x: P. Anandacharlu was associated with Chittoor, Nyapathi Subbarao with Rajahmundry, and Gutti Kesava Pillai with Anantapur. P. Rangaiah Naidu is the remaining entry without a district specified in the list.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure regional pairings and eliminate the remaining code.
accepted.sec: Andhra delegates at early INC sessions

accepted.s: Who presided over the 1887 Madras session of the Indian National Congress?
accepted.x: Badruddin Tyabji presided over the 1887 Madras session of the INC.
accepted.tq: Use the session year and venue to distinguish the early INC presidents.
accepted.sec: Andhra delegates at early INC sessions

accepted.s: Who was the first Telugu woman to participate as a delegate in the Indian National Congress?
accepted.x: Ponaka Kanakamma was the first Telugu woman in the Indian National Congress.
accepted.tq: Identify the person associated with a specific first in regional political participation.
accepted.sec: Andhra delegates at early INC sessions

accepted.s: Andhra Prakasika is correctly associated with which person?
accepted.x: The pairing of Andhra Prakasika with P. Anandacharyulu is accepted as correct.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between closely associated newspaper editors and founders.

accepted.s: Krishna Patrika was published from Machilipatnam in 1902 under the association of:
accepted.x: Krishna Patrika was associated with Konda Venkatappayya and was published from Machilipatnam in 1902.
accepted.tq: Combine the newspaper, place and year with its associated person.

accepted.s: Nyapathi Subbarao was associated as editor with which of the following publications?
accepted.x: Nyapathi Subbarao was associated as editor with the monthly publications Vyjayanti and People's Magazine.
accepted.tq: Match the editor with the pair of publications linked to him.

accepted.s: By 1905, approximately how many Telugu journals were in circulation among the nationalist publications of Andhra?
accepted.x: By 1905, there were approximately 20 Telugu journals, including Deshabhimani, Sasilekha, Rasikollasini and Gowtami.
accepted.tq: Identify the approximate count rather than confusing it with a precise enumeration.

accepted.s: The nationalist journals of Andhra during 1885–1905 primarily:
o: Supported administrative failures and opposed democratic ideas
Criticised administrative failures and spread nationalism and democracy
accepted.x: These journals criticised administrative failures and helped spread nationalism and democratic ideas.
accepted.tq: Apply the stated function of the press to its political role.

accepted.s: Which one of the following was NOT among the early demands of the Indian National Congress in 1885?
o: Simultaneous ICS examination in England and India
accepted.x: The early demands included simultaneous ICS examinations, elected legislative councils and reduction of military expenditure. Complete independence was not among the listed demands of 1885.
accepted.tq: Find the later nationalist objective inserted into an early moderate demand list.

accepted.s: The early Congress opposed the annexation of:
accepted.x: One of the early Congress demands was opposition to the annexation of Upper Burma.
accepted.tq: Identify the specific territory in the moderate nationalist demand list.

accepted.s: Who presented a data-led critique of the economic drain from Madras against Andhra at the 7th Andhra Mahasabha in Guntur in 1919?
accepted.x: Gadicherla Harisarvottama Rao presented the data-led drain critique at the 7th Andhra Mahasabha in Guntur in 1919.
accepted.tq: Link the economic argument with its speaker, venue and occasion.

accepted.s: The division between Moderates and Extremists in the nationalist movement became prominent in:
accepted.x: The Moderate–Extremist divide became prominent in 1905.
accepted.tq: Separate the year of ideological division from the years of institutional formation.

accepted.s: The opposition of the Andhras to the transfer of Ganjam to Orissa was regarded as their:
accepted.x: The Andhra opposition to the transfer of Ganjam to Orissa was regarded as the first victory of the Andhra political movement.
accepted.tq: Identify the significance attached to a specific regional political action.

accepted.s: Who served as the municipal president of Kakinada during the early phase of Andhra political activity?
accepted.x: Paidah Ramakrishnayya served as the municipal president of Kakinada.
accepted.tq: Match the municipal centre with its local political leader.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly represents the significance of the nationalist movement in Andhra before 1905?
o: It rejected both constitutional politics and public associations.
Moderates, district associations and the press helped build Andhra's political base before the Vande Mataram phase.
It began only after the formation of the first district association in 1916.
It was confined entirely to municipal politics and had no press support.
accepted.x: Moderate leaders, district associations and nationalist newspapers collectively built Andhra's political base before the Vande Mataram phase of 1905.
accepted.tq: Combine institutional, political and press developments to infer their broader significance.

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly matched?
o: Krishna Patrika — first Telugu journal, Bellary Mission
Krishna district — first district association in Andhra, 1892
Andhra Prakasika — municipal president of Kakinada
Vande Mataram phase — before the growth of district associations
accepted.x: Krishna district had the first district association in Andhra in 1892. Krishna Patrika was published from Machilipatnam, while Satyadoota was associated with the Bellary Christian Mission.
accepted.tq: Compare the firsts and distinguish organisations, publications and political phases.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following developments in chronological order:
A. First session of the Indian National Congress
B. Formation of the Madras Mahajana Sabha
C. Formation of the Krishna District Association
D. Publication of Krishna Patrika
accepted.x: The Madras Mahajana Sabha was founded in 1884, the first INC session was held in 1885, the Krishna District Association was formed in 1892, and Krishna Patrika appeared in 1902.
accepted.tq: Place the dated institutional and press developments from earliest to latest.
